name: rust-bundled-library
goal: Pinned Rust tools load bundled LLVM on clean macOS without host-owned symlinks; native and Wasm builds retain the pinned compiler and existing budgets.

evidence: PR6 macOS artifact 7c9ad7cf fails snapshot setup: Rust linker and strip tools cannot load bundled libLLVM. Local target-lib symlink masks it. Isolated copies reproduce identical dyld failure.

Frozen test/pinned-toolchain-runtime.test.ts fails on unchanged launcher: rust-lld exits by signal because bundled LLVM is outside its rpath. Fixture copies only distributed files; host installation is unchanged.

Put the selected toolchain library directory in the child loader environment, reusing the selected bin directory. Run actual isolated linker and strip binaries in the normal test suite; retain compiler pin and budgets.
Child tools receive the pinned library directory and reuse one bin lookup. Added an own-unit recorded selection scenario; no host writes or budget edits.
Final frozen V2 tests: original launcher 2 failed/7 passed; repaired launcher 9 passed. The corrected Wasm-flavor fixture is identical across those two runs.
Original-source mutation fails real isolated linker loading; restored source passes. Both frozen test hashes and phase logs are recorded in rust-bundled-library-isolated-red-green-v2.json.
Full check: 3,474 passed. Snapshot be54116e passed seven gates (record 203752e044fd). Cold Rust/Wasm build and prevention guard passed.
